title: AIFaultBench: A Reproducible Benchmark of Real-World Faults in AI Software Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.41094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-based software systems remain difficult to debug because their failures can involve interactions among code, models, data, dependencies, hardware, and execution environments. Existing benchmarks cover specific classes of AI systems, while concerns about fault realism and reproducibility highlight the need for documented execution conditions and evidence. We present AIFaultBench, a benchmark of 770 real-world bugs from 105 AI-based software repositories across 76 organizations. It covers six classes of AI systems: machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, systems based on large language models, agentic AI, and AI tooling and infrastructure. Each bug record connects the original report and affected codebase to structured metadata, environment setup scripts, a reproduction trigger, and investigation evidence. We reproduced 652 bugs (84.7%) under the recorded execution conditions and documented the outcomes of the remaining

translated_title: AIFaultBench：AI软件系统中真实故障的可复现基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于AI的软件系统仍然难以调试，因为其故障可能涉及代码、模型、数据、依赖项、硬件和执行环境之间的复杂交互。现有基准测试仅覆盖特定类别的AI系统，而对故障真实性和可复现性的担忧凸显了对文档化执行条件和证据的需求。我们提出了AIFaultBench，这是一个包含来自76个组织的105个基于AI的软件仓库中770个真实漏洞的基准测试。它涵盖六类AI系统：机器学习、深度学习、强化学习、基于大语言模型的系统、智能体AI以及AI工具与基础设施。每个漏洞记录将原始报告和受影响的代码库与结构化元数据、环境设置脚本、复现触发器和调查证据相连接。我们在记录的执行条件下成功复现了652个漏洞（84.7%），并记录了其余漏洞的结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了AIFaultBench，一个涵盖六类AI系统、包含来自105个软件仓库的770个真实故障的可复现基准测试，在文档化执行条件下成功复现了84.7%的故障，为AI软件调试研究提供了真实且可验证的故障资源。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AIFaultBench, a reproducible benchmark of 770 real-world bugs from 105 AI-based software repositories covering six classes of AI systems, with 84.7% of faults successfully reproduced under documented execution conditions, providing realistic and verifiable fault resources for AI software debugging research.
